summary: Official Ondo State land-administration and survey materials establish a local custodian route relevant to Ore, but bounded anonymous requests found no public parcel geometry, stable native parcel identity, schema, CRS or city adapter. Runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Yoruba discovery queries are recorded in city-5192-ore.json. English discovery found the official Ondo State Ministry LandsApp and Surveyor-General procedure. Yoruba discovery found no first-party Yoruba parcel viewer or API; official English materials remained the relevant first-party sources.
requestOutcomes: Official portal landing, service catalogue, guest guidance, documents, tracking, survey-plan PDF, federal cadastral description and robots route were fetched anonymously with TLS verification enabled. No login, credentials, approval code, formal request, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass or unsafe property lookup was used.
scopeLimits: The official Ondo State ministry and surveyor-general materials prove a local custodian/procedure route, not public parcel geometry availability.
The service catalogue exposes applications and restricted/approval-code workflows; no parcel API or public map layer was returned.
Federal Surveyor-General cadastral prose is national-agency context and was not treated as Ore-specific source integration.
No exact-point hit or miss, map extent miss, timeout, login wall or unusable UI was treated as evidence of citywide cadastral absence, and the WUP point was not shifted.
No GeoJSON sample was retained because no safe native parcel geometry and identity response was obtained.
This packet is research evidence only and must not be treated as source integration or adapter admission.
nativeIdentityPolicy: No native parcel identity was observed; do not synthesize one from service rows, search results, response order or internal records.
crs: unverified; no parcel geometry response obtained
geometryQuality: not evaluated; no parcel geometry retained
serialReviewerQualification: not qualified; independent serial review and adapter qualification still required
uncertainty: A restricted, account-gated, approval-code or unpublished cadastral service may exist behind the official Ondo State workflow. Public availability, parcel schema, CRS, native identity, coverage and safe anonymous runtime access remain unresolved.
